title: MV Update / New Release of my game: Back in Boulder

posts.author: Gazz
posts.body:
Hello everyone, months ago, I published a game with a classic theme of
revolution
but with a twist of
searching for meaning in life
. Some tried the game, liked it and gave some feedback too so I found the time to work on an update. I thank everyone who played and will play it, all I want is for you to have some fun!! And give feedback too, if you want, since it's also helpful to me!
It, currently, has about 2h30 of gameplay and there's a link for a video with the full game (the older version tho), in case you want to watch.
Here's the video:
The update includes:
New Sprites and Audio were added; Achievements, fast foward, auto batte, backlogs and ambient light were implemented; An extra scene was made along with dialogue fixes.

Back in Boulder;

Description:
Step into the kingdom of Boulder, a land weighed down by oppression but brimming with the hope of revolution.
Back in Boulder
is a compelling narrative RPG that weaves a tale of purpose, unity, and the resilience of those who fight for freedom. Play as Gazz, a wanderer who once saw himself as aimless but is thrust into the heart of a revolution that will reshape the future of Boulder. Alongside a diverse cast of allies like the passionate Boreal and the steadfast Ricky. Forge your path through intense battles, heartfelt relationships, and choices that will define not only Gazz’s purpose but the fate of an entire kingdom;
Free to Play Status:
Free;
Involvement:
Developer.
It contains use of AI for images and music: I'm just a game dev, not an artist nor composer, so go easy on me
